explanations: The hotel-side item's sort key is STAY#<checkIn>#<guestId>, which is only unique if a guest never has two reservations arriving the same day at the same hotel. When they do, the second put has the same pk + sk and silently replaces the first (puts are upserts), so the arrivals sheet, occupancy and the oversell check all see one room while the guest-side items (keyed by reservation id) still show two. Cancelling either one then deletes the shared hotel item. Ending the sort key with the reservation id keeps the arrival-date prefix for range queries and makes every item's key unique.
